interpretation: Each digit is a multiplier of a common base time interval. Repeat all 20 digits as one cycle. These are not literal model-time intervals of 1, 2 and 3.
comparison: Within each level and speed profile, identical duration, method, spatial grid, step count and RHS evaluation count. Reverse means reverse the entire 20-step cycle.
accuracy_and_conservation_budgets: Reuse adaptive_transport_plan.json unchanged. Measure errors at every accepted step, plus endpoint error at the common final time.
raw_outputs: All accepted times and diagnostic arrays; full spatial state at each cycle boundary. No interpolation of state snapshots.
scope: Deterministic prescribed advection benchmark. No sequence optimization, spatial adaptation, experimental data or stochastic sampling. Repeat two selected finest-grid cases for reproducibility.
